entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For order status, press one. For technical support, press two. For returns or exchanges, press three. To speak to an agent, say 'Agent'.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?

Finally! I ordered a jersey, and it's completely the wrong size. It's way too tight! I can barely breathe in this thing. What kind of sizing chart are you people even using? This is completely unacceptable.
I'm very sorry to hear that the fit wasn't right. I can definitely look into this for you. Do you have your order number handy?

Yes, it's VF88602. I don't want to 'look into it,' I want to fix it. I need an exchange for a size that actually fits a human being, and I need it now. If you can't do that, I'm writing a review on every single cycling forum on the internet about this.

I understand your frustration, and I assure you, we'll get this sorted out. Thank you for the order number. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Line jersey, delivered 17 days ago.
Yeah, 17 days of it sitting in a box because I've been too angry to even call you people. Are you going to help me or are you going to waste my time? Get me a manager if you can't do your job.
There's no need for that, I can absolutely handle this for you. I see here that you found the jersey was too tight and you'd like to get the correct size. Let me just check our policy.
You'd better. I'm a VIP member, you know. I spend a lot of money here.

Yes, I see that and we appreciate your loyalty. Okay, I've checked the policy, and you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. We can definitely process an exchange for you right away. What size would you like to get instead?
A large. Just send me a large. And you're going to pay for the shipping both ways, right?

Of course. I've just processed the order for the new jersey in a size large. And for the trouble and the incorrect sizing, I've gone ahead and upgraded you to complimentary expedited shipping, so it should be there in 1-2 business days. I'm also emailing you a pre-paid return label for the one that was the wrong size. You can just drop that in the mail at your convenience.
Oh. Well... okay. That's... better. One to two days, you said?
That's correct. We want to make sure you have gear that you're comfortable in. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
